description: Use for 'what should I look at today?' or 'who is worth a call?'. Returns the leads in today's note: for each, what we found (dated, with links), what it usually means for what you sell, who to reach and why, and roughly how much time there is. If no note went out yet today, returns what the next one would hold. Quiet days return nothing; that is normal. Saved records only.
name: get_daily_brief

best_contact.description: The person named for the lead, when one is. Never an email for EU, EEA or UK companies.

opportunity_id.description: Lead id (eop_...), a match of the workspace's own rule (rh_...) or of one of its buying signals (dh_...).

quote.description: The verbatim words from the source, when we have them. Present when buying signals are switched on for the workspace.

signal_id.description: The buying signal line this matches, or null for a lead. Present when buying signals are switched on for the workspace.

signal_label.description: That line in the workspace's own words. Present when buying signals are switched on for the workspace.

source_url.description: The link the quote is on. Present when buying signals are switched on for the workspace.

timing.description: Empty for a buying signal match whose line states no time frame.

what_we_found.description: The dated public proof, each with a link to its source when there is one.

dated.description: For a buying signal match: how the source dates the quote, such as published Oct 3.

status.description: sent: today's note went out. next: what the next note would hold. none: nothing to send.

title: Today's note
